# Emergency Medicine — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the role of Emergency Medicine?", "trauma, acute care"),
    ("What category is Emergency Medicine?", "emergency"),
    ("What is category?", "emergency"),
    ("What is role?", "trauma, acute care"),
    ("What is sources/training?", "3-4 years residency"),
    ("What is note?", "The ER front line"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
